    - img "Plus"
    - text: ADVANCED COMMAND-AND-CONTROL SOFTWARE
    - heading "Autonomy unlocked." [level=2]
    - paragraph: Echelon is built to command the most advanced autonomous fleets on the water. By tightly integrating software and hardware, it avoids the compromises of bolt-on C2—delivering faster decisions, smarter behaviors, and mission-specific control at scale.
    - img "Purpose-Built Interface"
    - heading "Purpose-Built Interface" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Access the full fidelity of Saronic's proprietary autonomy through a custom-tuned UI.
    - img "Native Behavior Control"
    - heading "Native Behavior Control" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Unlock differentiated autonomy behaviors not possible with third-party systems.
    - img "Optimized for Reality"

    - paragraph: Mission planning and C2 logic matched to real-world vessel performance.
    - img "Integrated by Design"

    - img "Built for Evolution"

    - paragraph: Engineered to enable multi-asset learning, edge AI, and collaborative behaviors.
    - img "Informed in Real-Time"

    - paragraph: Live telemetry and autonomy-aware alerts keep operators focused on what matters.

    - text: S/003
    - heading "Real-Time Adjustments" [level=3]

    - text: 3 / 3Execute

    - paragraph: Seamlessly move from test to live execution with zero mission degradation.
